name: Wall of Metal

heightening.text: The wall is high-grade silver or standard-grade dawnsilver.
The wall is standard-grade cold iron.
The wall is high-grade cold iron or standard-grade adamantine.

entries: You call forth a sheet of metal, forming a wall of iron, low-grade cold iron, or standard-grade silver up to 60 feet long, 30 feet high, and 1/4 inch thick. The wall doesn't need to stand vertically but must form a straight line in an unbroken open space so it doesn't pass through any creatures or objects, or the spell is lost. Each 10-foot-by-10- foot section of the wall has AC 10 and is immune to critical hits and precision damage. The wall's Hardness, HP, and BT use the statistics of a structure of the material you chose (see GM Core for material statistics). Creatures can move through a section of the wall that's broken.
